mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ha_workspace_file ( owner_key, agent_key, scope_key, workspace_area, file_kind, write_policy, path_hash, file_path, content_ref, checksum_sha256, size_bytes, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{ownerKey}, #{agentKey}, #{scopeKey}, #{workspaceArea}, #{fileKind}, #{writePolicy}, #{pathHash}, #{filePath}, #{contentRef}, #{checksumSha256}, #{sizeBytes}, 1, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )

INSERT INTO ha_workspace_operation ( owner_key, agent_key, scope_key, path_hash, file_path, operation_id, operation_type, actor_type, session_id, turn_id, tool_call_id, change_json, applied_version, created_at, actor_id, before_version, after_version, before_ref, after_ref, before_checksum, after_checksum, before_size, after_size ) VALUES ( #{ownerKey}, #{agentKey}, #{scopeKey}, #{pathHash}, #{filePath}, #{operationId}, #{operationType}, #{actorType}, #{sessionId}, #{turnId}, #{toolCallId}, #{changeJson}, #{appliedVersion}, #{createdAt}, #{actorId}, #{beforeVersion}, #{afterVersion}, #{beforeRef}, #{afterRef}, #{beforeChecksum}, #{afterChecksum}, #{beforeSize}, #{afterSize} )
